summary: WriteExecutor now renews active owned leases throughout slow pre-dispatch validation and fails closed before dispatch on ownership loss.
findings: A per-batch heartbeat renews leases every third of the configured lease window and performs explicit ownership checks before prepare and commitDispatch.
Rejected, released, and stale items are removed from the active heartbeat set before their queue transition, preventing unnecessary renewal.
Focused tests cover validation beyond the original lease duration and prove that a short renewal count prevents admission, prepare, and dispatch.
evidence_refs: pnpm run format:check; pnpm run lint; pnpm run typecheck; pnpm run test:unit (115 passed)
PostgreSQL 18 migrations and full integration suite (31 passed)
residual_risks: An in-flight live read cannot be cancelled by the heartbeat, but any recorded heartbeat failure is checked before the item can reach reservation, prepare, or dispatch.
